g.text: P123-RFI-0002: Conflict in piling and utilities at AZ203
P123-RFI-0002 Awaiting response Request for information class internal
subject: Conflict in piling and utilities at AZ203
question: The piling layout in revision B puts pile P-17 inside the route of the fuel gas line
47-P-101, and the utilities drawing shows the same corridor for the cooling water return.
Please confirm which of the two keeps the corridor, whether the pile can move 400 mm to the
east without a new load calculation, and whether the cooling water line may be re-routed above
the beam B12 if the pile stays where it is. We need the answer before the pile cap formwork is
raiser expects: cost unknown, schedule unknown
